name: ProportionStrip
description:
A part-to-whole in one line: the micro tier of pie, donut, treemap and sunburst. Segments in
order, separated by the 2px surface gap, the whole bar's ends rounded.
signature: ({ items, width, height, rem }: { items: readonly StripItem[]; width: number; height: number; rem: number; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the box in px; the bar is centred in it, at most 0.5rem thick.

props.name: items
props.description: The collection rendered by the component. Stable identifiers preserve selection and keyboard focus.

props.name: rem
props.description: px per rem, for the bar's thickness.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the strip's box in px; segments share it after the 2px gaps.
